notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo build of Numb to provide a better user experience with fewer distractions on the interface side of things.

[h2]📄 Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] The interface now aligns with the progression of the storyline:
[list]
[*] The bullet bar is not shown until the gun is obtained
[*] The courage bar has been hidden
[/list]
[*] Some features that are supposed to be activated later in the plot have been removed to avoid confusion, such as:
[list]
[*] The ability to close one's eyes to escape dangers
[*] The ability to crouch
[/list]
[*] Hazards in the last part of the demo have been repositioned to teach the player the shooting mechanic, requiring them to load and fire to progress, thus avoiding the sense of frustration many encountered when unable to complete the demo
[*] It is now easier to escape from the unknown and return home
[*] Fixed some issues related to auto-movement in scripted sections
[*] Rebalanced sanity consumption to make it more fair
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]



As usual, we invite you to wishlist the game and try out the demo 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2458780/Numb__Just_dont_think_about_it/
